FILE: .\daily-backup.sh
============================================================
00001: #!/bin/bash
00002: # daily-backup.sh – run as a cron job on the host
00003: DATE=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)
00004: docker exec pcea-connect-db-1 pg_dump -U pcea pcea > /backups/pcea_$DATE.sql
00005: find /backups -name "*.sql" -mtime +7 -delete

00003: 
00004: # 1. Update system & install Docker
00005: sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y docker.io docker-compose-v2 nginx certbot python3-certbot-nginx
00006: 
00007: # 2. Clone repository (or copy files via scp)
00008: # git clone https://github.com/your-org/pcea-connect.git
00009: # cd pcea-connect
00010: 
00011: # 3. Create .env file with production secrets
00012: echo "DB_PASSWORD=your_strong_password" > .env
00013: echo "JWT_SECRET=your_256_bit_secret" >> .env
00014: echo "MPESA_CONSUMER_KEY=..." >> .env
00015: echo "MPESA_CONSUMER_SECRET=..." >> .env
00016: echo "MPESA_PASSKEY=..." >> .env
00017: echo "MPESA_SHORTCODE=..." >> .env
00018: echo "MPESA_CALLBACK_URL=https://pcea-connect.com/api/giving/mpesa-callback" >> .env
00019: 
00020: # 4. Start everything
00021: sudo docker-compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d
00022: 
00023: # 5. Obtain SSL certificate (after DNS points to this server)
00024: # sudo certbot --nginx -d pcea-connect.com -d www.pcea-connect.com

FILE: .\docs\01-Executive-Summary.md
============================================================
00001: # PCEA Connect – Executive Summary
00002: **Version 1.0 | July 2026 | Afrika Digitalis**
00003: 
00004: ## What is PCEA Connect?
00005: PCEA Connect is the official digital operating system for the Presbyterian Church of East Africa. It combines church administration, daily member engagement, and communication tools into a single, modern platform.
00006: 
00007: ## Why Was It Built?
00008: The PCEA needed a digital backbone to connect its 4+ million members across Kenya, Tanzania, and beyond. Existing solutions were fragmented, desktop-only, or failed to capture the church's unique hierarchy and ministry structure.
00009: 
00010: ## What Problem Does It Solve?
00011: - Disconnected congregations ? real-time communication and a shared church directory.
00012: - Manual administration ? digital membership, attendance, events, and reports.
00013: - Limited giving options ? M-Pesa integration, statements, and donor history.
00014: - Youth disengagement ? social feed, Bible streaks, livestream, and ministry communities.
00015: - No leadership visibility ? drill-down analytics from National to Congregation level.
00016: 
00017: ## Who Uses It?
00018: - Members – daily Bible reading, giving, events, prayer requests.
00019: - Ministers & Elders – pastoral care, attendance, member management.
00020: - Treasurers – financial contributions, M-Pesa reconciliation, reports.
00021: - Youth Leaders – youth fellowship feed, events, mentorship.
00022: - Church Administrators – church hierarchy, roles, audit logs.
00023: - National Leadership – real-time dashboards and exports.
00024: 
00025: ## Deployment
00026: Pilot: Single congregation on a cloud server (Hetzner CX11). Scale: Docker Compose with PostgreSQL, Redis, Nginx.
00027: 
00028: ## Contact
00029: Afrika Digitalis

00001: # PCEA Connect – Product Vision
00002: **Version 1.0 | July 2026**
00003: 
00004: ## Our Mission
00005: To be the digital operating system of the Presbyterian Church of East Africa, connecting every member, ministry, and leader.
00006: 
00007: ## Product Pillars
00008: 1. Member Engagement – daily Bible, feed, events, prayer.
00009: 2. Church Administration – membership, attendance, committees.
00010: 3. Financial Stewardship – M-Pesa giving, statements, budgets.
00011: 4. Communication – announcements, SMS, WhatsApp, USSD.
00012: 5. Pastoral Care – prayer requests, visits, tasks.
00013: 6. Ministry Collaboration – each ministry has its own hub.
00014: 7. Leadership Intelligence – drill-down analytics, CSV/PDF exports.
00015: 
00016: ## Success Metrics (Pilot)
00017: - Weekly active users > 50%
00018: - Giving transactions > 10 per week
00019: - Event registrations > 5 per week
00020: - Prayer requests > 5 per week
00021: - Feed posts > 20 per week

FILE: .\docs\03-System-Architecture.md
============================================================
00001: # PCEA Connect – System Architecture
00002: **Version 1.0**
00003: 
00004: ## High-Level Architecture
00005: PCEA Connect follows a modular monolith pattern with separate frontend and backend.
00006: 
00007: - Frontend: Next.js 15 (TypeScript, Tailwind, ShadCN)
00008: - Backend: Spring Boot 3.2 (Kotlin, JWT, Flyway)
00009: - Database: PostgreSQL 15
00010: - Infrastructure: Docker Compose, Nginx
00011: 
00012: ## Technology Stack
00013: | Component | Technology |
00014: |-----------|-----------|
00015: | Backend | Kotlin, Spring Boot 3.2, Spring Security, JPA |
00016: | Frontend | Next.js 15, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, ShadCN |
00017: | Database | PostgreSQL 15 |
00018: | Payments | Safaricom Daraja API (M-Pesa) |
00019: | Messaging | Twilio (WhatsApp), Africa's Talking (SMS/USSD) |
00020: | Auth | JWT (access + refresh), BCrypt |
00021: | DevOps | Docker, Compose, GitHub Actions, Nginx |
00022: 
00023: ## Module Map
00024: | Module | Package | Key Entities |
00025: |--------|---------|--------------|
00026: | Identity | identity | User, RefreshToken |
00027: | Church | church | Region, Presbytery, Parish, Congregation |
00028: | Membership | membership | MemberProfile |
00029: | Events | events | Event, EventRegistration |
00030: | Giving | giving | Contribution, ContributionStatement |
00031: | Ministries | ministries | Ministry, MinistryMember |
00032: | Attendance | attendance | AttendanceRecord |
00033: | Pastoral Care | pastoralcare | Prayer, Visit, Task |

FILE: .\docs\10-Security.md
============================================================
00001: # PCEA Connect – Security
00002: **Version 1.0**
00003: 
00004: - JWT (HS256), BCrypt passwords
00005: - Public endpoints only /auth/**, /locator/**, /health
00006: - RBAC roles: MEMBER, ELDER, ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN, TREASURER, CLERK
00007: - Secrets in environment variables only
00008: - HTTPS via Nginx + Let's Encrypt
00009: - Audit logs for all sensitive actions
00010: - M-Pesa callback signature verification & idempotency
00011: - Daily PostgreSQL backups, monthly restore tests
00012: - Kenya Data Protection Act compliant

FILE: .\docs\Architecture.md
============================================================
00001: # Architecture
00002: 
00003: ## Overall Architecture
00004: PCEA Connect is a multi-tier application with the following layers:
00005: - **Frontend**: React-based Single Page Application (SPA) for user interaction.
00006: - **Backend**: Spring Boot application providing RESTful APIs.
00007: - **Database**: SQL database for persistent storage.
00008: 
00009: ## Module Relationships
00010: - **Frontend** communicates with the **Backend** via REST APIs.
00011: - **Backend** interacts with the **Database** for data storage and retrieval.
00012: 
00013: ## Request Flow
00014: 1. User sends a request from the frontend.
00015: 2. Backend processes the request and interacts with the database if needed.
00016: 3. Backend sends a response back to the frontend.
00017: 
00018: ## Data Flow
00019: - Data flows from the database to the backend and then to the frontend.
00020: - User inputs are validated at both the frontend and backend.
00021: 
00022: ## Dependency Graph
00023: - **Frontend**: React, TypeScript, npm packages.
00024: - **Backend**: Spring Boot, Gradle dependencies.
00025: - **Database**: SQL-based database (e.g., PostgreSQL).

FILE: .\docs\CodingStandards.md
============================================================
00001: # Coding Standards
00002: 
00003: ## SOLID Principles
00004: - Follow the SOLID principles to ensure maintainable and scalable code.
00005: 
00006: ## Clean Architecture
00007: - Separate concerns into layers (e.g., presentation, business logic, data).
00008: 
00009: ## Package Structure
00010: - Organize code into meaningful packages/modules.
00011: 
00012: ## Naming Conventions
00013: - Use descriptive and consistent names for variables, functions, and classes.
00014: 
00015: ## Error Handling
00016: - Handle errors gracefully and provide meaningful messages.
00017: 
00018: ## Testing Standards
00019: - Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests.
00020: - Aim for high test coverage.
00021: 
00022: ## Security Standards
00023: - Never hardcode secrets.
00024: - Validate and sanitize all user inputs.

FILE: .\docs\ProductVision.md
============================================================
00001: # Product Vision
00002: 
00003: ## Purpose
00004: PCEA Connect aims to provide a unified digital platform for the Presbyterian Church of East Africa, enabling seamless communication, administration, and engagement for its members and leadership.
00005: 
00006: ## Users
00007: - **Members**: Daily Bible reading, giving, events, prayer requests.
00008: - **Ministers & Elders**: Pastoral care, attendance, member management.
00009: - **Treasurers**: Financial contributions, M-Pesa reconciliation, reports.
00010: - **Youth Leaders**: Youth fellowship feed, events, mentorship.
00011: - **Church Administrators**: Church hierarchy, roles, audit logs.
00012: - **National Leadership**: Real-time dashboards and exports.
00013: 
00014: ## Goals
00015: - Connect 4+ million members across Kenya, Tanzania, and beyond.
00016: - Digitize church administration and member engagement.
00017: - Provide real-time analytics and reporting for leadership.
00018: 
00019: ## Non-goals
00020: - Replace in-person fellowship and worship.
00021: - Serve as a general-purpose social media platform.
00022: 
00023: ## Success Metrics
00024: - Adoption rate among congregations.
00025: - User engagement metrics (e.g., daily active users).
00026: - Financial contributions processed through the platform.

FILE: .\frontend\components\shared\ErrorBoundary.tsx
============================================================
00001: 'use client'
00002: import { Component, ReactNode } from 'react'
00003: 
00004: interface Props { children: ReactNode; fallback?: ReactNode }
00005: interface State { hasError: boolean }
00006: 
00007: export class ErrorBoundary extends Component<Props, State> {
00008:   state = { hasError: false }
00009:   static getDerivedStateFromError() { return { hasError: true } }
00010:   render() {
00011:     if (this.state.hasError) {
00012:       return this.props.fallback ?? (
00013:         <div className="p-6 text-center bg-gray-800 rounded-lg">
00014:           <p className="text-gray-300 mb-4">Something went wrong. Please try again.</p>
00015:           <button
00016:             onClick={() => this.setState({ hasError: false })}
00017:             className="px-4 py-2 bg-blue-600 rounded-lg text-white"
00018:           >
00019:             Retry
00020:           </button>
00021:         </div>
00022:       )
00023:     }
00024:     return this.props.children
00025:   }
00026: }

00001: "use client"
00002: import { useState } from "react"
00003: import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
00004: import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input"
00005: import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label"
00006: import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardFooter } from "@/components/ui/card"
00007: import { toast } from "sonner"
00008: import api from "@/lib/api"
00009: 
00010: export default function ForgotPasswordPage() {
00011:   const [email, setEmail] = useState("")
00012:   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)
00013: 
00014:   const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
00015:     e.preventDefault()
00016:     setLoading(true)

00018:       await api.post("/api/auth/forgot-password", { email })
00019:       toast.success("If this email exists, a reset link has been sent.")

00021:       toast.success("If this email exists, a reset link has been sent.")

00023:       setLoading(false)
00024:     }
00025:   }
00026:

00033:             <CardTitle className="text-2xl font-bold text-white">Forgot Password</CardTitle>

00001: "use client"
00002: import { useState } from "react"
00003: import { useRouter } from "next/navigation"
00004: import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
00005: import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input"
00006: import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label"
00007: import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardFooter } from "@/components/ui/card"
00008: import { toast } from "sonner"
00009: import api from "@/lib/api"
00010: 
00011: export default function LoginPage() {
00012:   const [email, setEmail] = useState("")
00013:   const [password, setPassword] = useState("")
00014:   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)
00015:   const [error, setError] = useState("")
00016:   const router = useRouter()
00017: 
00018:   const handleLogin = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
00019:     e.preventDefault()
00020:     setError("")
00021:     setLoading(true)
00022:     try {
00023:       const res = await api.post("/api/auth/login", { email, password })
00024:       if (res.data?.data?.accessToken) {
00025:         localStorage.setItem("token", res.data.data.accessToken)
00026:         toast.success("Welcome back!")
00027:         router.push("/dashboard")
00028:       } else {
00029:         setError("Invalid email or password.")
00030:       }
00031:     } catch (err: any) {
00032:       setError("Unable to sign in. Please check your connection and try again.")
00033:     } finally {
00034:       setLoading(false)
00035:     }
00036:   }
00037: 
00038:   return (
00039:     <div className="flex min-h-screen items-center justify-center bg-[#0B1622] p-4">
00040:       <Card className="w-full max-w-md backdrop-blur-sm bg-[#111827] border-0 shadow-2xl shadow-black/50 rounded-2xl">
00041:         <form onSubmit={handleLogin}>
00042:           <CardHeader className="items-center space-y-2">
00043:             <img src="/logo.png" alt="PCEA Connect" className="w-24 h-24 mb-4" />
00044:             <CardTitle className="text-2xl font-bold text-white">PCEA Connect</CardTitle>
00045:             <p className="text-sm text-gray-400">Sign in to your account</p>
00046:           </CardHeader>
00047:           <CardContent className="space-y-4">
00048:             <div>
00049:               <Label htmlFor="email" className="text-gray-300">Email</Label>
00050:               <Input id="email" type="email" placeholder="elder@test.com" value={email}
00051:                 onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)} required
00052:                 className="bg-gray-800 border-gray-700 text-white placeholder:text-gray-500" />
00053:             </div>
00054:             <div>
00055:               <Label htmlFor="password" className="text-gray-300">Password</Label>
00056:               <Input id="password" type="password" placeholder="••••••" value={password}
00057:                 onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)} required
00058:                 className="bg-gray-800 border-gray-700 text-white placeholder:text-gray-500" />
00059:             </div>
00060:             {error && (
00061:               <p className="text-sm text-red-400 bg-red-900/30 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-center">{error}</p>
00062:             )}
00063:             <Button type="submit" className="w-full bg-[#0B5E9C] hover:bg-[#0a4f87] text-white font-semibold"
00064:               disabled={loading}>{loading ? "Signing in…" : "Sign In"}</Button>
00065:           </CardContent>
00066:           <CardFooter className="flex flex-col gap-2">
00067:             <a href="/forgot-password" className="text-blue-400 hover:underline text-sm">Forgot password?</a>
00068:             <p className="text-sm text-gray-400">
00069:               Don&apos;t have an account?{" "}
00070:               <a href="/register" className="text-blue-400 hover:underline">Register</a>
00071:             </p>
00072:           </CardFooter>
00073:         </form>
00074:       </Card>
00075:     </div>
00076:   )

00001: "use client"
00002: import { useState } from "react"
00003: import { useRouter } from "next/navigation"
00004: import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
00005: import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input"
00006: import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label"
00007: import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardFooter } from "@/components/ui/card"
00008: import api from "@/lib/api"
00009: 
00010: export default function RegisterPage() {
00011:   const [email, setEmail] = useState("")
00012:   const [password, setPassword] = useState("")
00013:   const [fullName, setFullName] = useState("")
00014:   const [phone, setPhone] = useState("")
00015:   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)
00016:   const [error, setError] = useState("")
00017:   const [success, setSuccess] = useState("")
00018:   const router = useRouter()
00019: 
00020:   const handleRegister = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
00021:     e.preventDefault()
00022:     setError("")
00023:     setSuccess("")
00024:     setLoading(true)
00025:     try {
00026:       const res = await api.post("/api/auth/register", { email, password, fullName, phone })
00027:       if (res.data?.success) {
00028:         setSuccess("Registration successful! Redirecting to login…")
00029:         setTimeout(() => router.push("/login"), 1500)
00030:       } else {
00031:         setError(res.data?.message || "Registration failed.")
00032:       }
00033:     } catch (err: any) {
00034:       if (err.response?.status === 400) {
00035:         setError("This email is already registered. Please log in instead.")
00036:       } else {

00001: "use client"

00012:   const [results, setResults] = useState<any>(null)
00013:

00017:   }
00018:

00025:       </div>

00041:               </div>

00046:     </div>

FILE: .\frontend\src\components\error-boundary.tsx
============================================================
00001: "use client"
00002: import { Component, ReactNode } from "react"
00003: 
00004: export class ErrorBoundary extends Component<{ children: ReactNode; fallback?: ReactNode }, { hasError: boolean }> {
00005:   constructor(props: any) {
00006:     super(props)
00007:     this.state = { hasError: false }
00008:   }
00009:   static getDerivedStateFromError() { return { hasError: true } }
00010:   render() {
00011:     if (this.state.hasError) {
00012:       return this.props.fallback || <div className="p-8 text-center text-gray-400">Something went wrong. Please try again.</div>
00013:     }
00014:     return this.props.children
00015:   }
00016: }

FILE: .\frontend\src\components\theme-toggle.tsx
============================================================
00001: "use client"
00002: import { useTheme } from "next-themes"
00003: import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
00004: import { Sun, Moon } from "lucide-react"
00005: import { useEffect, useState } from "react"
00006: 
00007: export function ThemeToggle() {
00008:   const { theme, setTheme } = useTheme()
00009:   const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false)
00010:   useEffect(() => setMounted(true), [])
00011:   if (!mounted) return null
00012:   return (
00013:     <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" onClick={() => setTheme(theme === "dark" ? "light" : "dark")}>
00014:       {theme === "dark" ? <Sun className="h-5 w-5" /> : <Moon className="h-5 w-5" />}
00015:     </Button>
00016:   )
00017: }

FILE: .\frontend\src\lib\auth.ts
============================================================
00001: export function getUserId(): string | null {
00002:   if (typeof window === "undefined") return null
00003:   const token = localStorage.getItem("token")
00004:   if (!token) return null
00005:   try {
00006:     const payload = JSON.parse(atob(token.split(".")[1]))
00007:     return payload.sub || null
00008:   } catch {
00009:     return null
00010:   }
00011: }

00001: package ke.pcea.connect.config
00002: import ke.pcea.connect.shared.security.JwtAuthFilter
00003: import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value
00004: import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean
00005: import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration
00006: import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.method.configuration.EnableMethodSecurity
00007: import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.builders.HttpSecurity
00008: import org.springframework.security.config.http.SessionCreationPolicy
00009: import org.springframework.security.crypto.bcrypt.BCryptPasswordEncoder
00010: import org.springframework.security.crypto.password.PasswordEncoder
00011: import org.springframework.security.web.SecurityFilterChain
00012: import org.springframework.security.web.authentication.UsernamePasswordAuthenticationFilter
00013: import org.springframework.web.cors.CorsConfiguration
00014: import org.springframework.web.cors.CorsConfigurationSource
00015: import org.springframework.web.cors.UrlBasedCorsConfigurationSource
00016: 
00017: @Configuration
00018: @EnableMethodSecurity
00019: class SecurityConfig(
00020:     private val jwtAuthFilter: JwtAuthFilter,
00021:     @Value("\${mpesa.callback-secret}") private val mpesaCallbackSecret: String
00022: ) {
00023: 
00024:     @Bean
00025:     fun securityFilterChain(http: HttpSecurity): SecurityFilterChain {
00026:         http
00027:             .cors { it.configurationSource(corsConfigurationSource()) }
00028:             .csrf { it.disable() }
00029:             .sessionManagement { it.sessionCreationPolicy(SessionCreationPolicy.STATELESS) }
00030:             .authorizeHttpRequests {
00031:                 it.requestMatchers("/api/auth/**", "/api/locator/**", "/api/health", "/h2-console/**").permitAll()
00032:                 // M-Pesa's servers call this webhook with no JWT, so it must stay public â€” but the
00033:                 // secret path segment (validated in MpesaCallbackController) is what stops anyone
00034:                 // else from POSTing fake payment confirmations to it.
00035:                 it.requestMatchers("/api/giving/mpesa-callback/$mpesaCallbackSecret").permitAll()
00036:                 it.anyRequest().authenticated()
00037:             }
00038:             .addFilterBefore(jwtAuthFilter, UsernamePasswordAuthenticationFilter::class.java)
00039:             .headers { it.frameOptions { fo -> fo.disable() } }
00040:         return http.build()
00041:     }
00042: 
00043:     @Bean
00044:     fun corsConfigurationSource(): CorsConfigurationSource {
00045:         val configuration = CorsConfiguration()
00046:         configuration.allowedOrigins = listOf(
00047:             "http://localhost:3000", "http://localhost:3001", "http://localhost:3002",
00048:             "http://192.168.1.23:3000"
00049:         )
00050:         configuration.allowedMethods = listOf("*")
00051:         configuration.allowedHeaders = listOf("*")
00052:         configuration.allowCredentials = true
00053:         val source = UrlBasedCorsConfigurationSource()
00054:         source.registerCorsConfiguration("/**", configuration)
00055:         return source
00056:     }
00057: 
00058:     @Bean fun passwordEncoder(): PasswordEncoder = BCryptPasswordEncoder()
00059: }

FILE: .\src\main\kotlin\ke\pcea\connect\modules\analytics\application\AnalyticsService.kt
============================================================
00001: package ke.pcea.connect.modules.analytics.application
00002: import ke.pcea.connect.modules.attendance.infrastructure.AttendanceRepository
00003: import ke.pcea.connect.modules.church.infrastructure.*
00004: import ke.pcea.connect.modules.events.infrastructure.EventRepository
00005: import ke.pcea.connect.modules.events.domain.EventStatus
00006: import ke.pcea.connect.modules.giving.infrastructure.ContributionRepository
00007: import ke.pcea.connect.modules.giving.domain.PaymentStatus
00008: import ke.pcea.connect.modules.identity.infrastructure.UserRepository
00009: import ke.pcea.connect.modules.ministries.infrastructure.MinistryRepository
00010: import ke.pcea.connect.modules.analytics.api.dto.*
00011: import org.springframework.stereotype.Service
00012: import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional
00013: import java.time.LocalDate
00014: import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter
00015: 
00016: @Service
00017: @Transactional(readOnly = true)
00018: class AnalyticsService(
00019:     private val userRepo: UserRepository,
00020:     private val attendanceRepo: AttendanceRepository,
00021:     private val contributionRepo: ContributionRepository,
00022:     private val ministryRepo: MinistryRepository,
00023:     private val eventRepo: EventRepository,
00024:     private val congregationRepo: CongregationRepository,
00025:     private val parishRepo: ParishRepository,
00026:     private val presbyteryRepo: PresbyteryRepository,
00027:     private val regionRepo: RegionRepository
00028: ) {
00029:     fun getCongregationMetrics(congregationId: String): DashboardMetrics {
00030:         val totalMembers = userRepo.countByCongregationId(congregationId)
00031:         val today = LocalDate.now()
00032:         val attendanceToday = attendanceRepo.countByCongregationIdAndDate(congregationId, today).toDouble()
00033:         val attendanceRate = if (totalMembers > 0) attendanceToday / totalMembers else 0.0
00034:         val sum = contributionRepo.sumAmountByCongregationIdAndStatus(congregationId, PaymentStatus.COMPLETED)
00035:         val totalGiving = sum ?: java.math.BigDecimal.ZERO
00036:         val activeMinistries = ministryRepo.countByCongregationId(congregationId).toInt()
00037:         val upcomingEvents = eventRepo.countByStatus(EventStatus.PUBLISHED).toInt()
00038:         return DashboardMetrics(totalMembers, totalMembers, attendanceRate, totalGiving, activeMinistries, upcomingEvents)
00039:     }
00040: 
00041:     fun getTrends(congregationId: String): List<TrendData> {
00042:         // Simulated monthly trends for the last 6 months
00043:         val months = (5 downTo 0).map {
00044:             LocalDate.now().minusMonths(it.toLong()).format(DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("MMM yyyy"))
00045:         }
00046:         val givingTrend = TrendData("Giving (KES)", months.map { TrendPoint(it, (5000 + Math.random() * 10000).toLong().coerceIn(0, Long.MAX_VALUE).toDouble().toDouble()) })
00047:         val attendanceTrend = TrendData("Attendance", months.map { TrendPoint(it, (50 + Math.random() * 50).toLong().coerceIn(0, Long.MAX_VALUE).toDouble().toDouble()) })
00048:         val memberTrend = TrendData("Members", months.map { TrendPoint(it, (100 + Math.random() * 20).toLong().coerceIn(0, Long.MAX_VALUE).toDouble().toDouble()) })
00049:         return listOf(givingTrend, attendanceTrend, memberTrend)
00050:     }
00051: 
00052:     fun getDrillDown(level: String, id: String): DrillDownMetrics {
00053:         val (name, metrics) = when (level) {
00054:             "congregation" -> {
00055:                 val c = congregationRepo.findById(id).orElse(null)
00056:                 (c?.name ?: "Unknown") to getCongregationMetrics(id)
00057:             }
00058:             "parish" -> {
00059:                 val p = parishRepo.findById(id).orElse(null)
00060:                 (p?.name ?: "Unknown") to getParishMetrics(id)
00061:             }
00062:             "presbytery" -> {
00063:                 val p = presbyteryRepo.findById(id).orElse(null)
00064:                 (p?.name ?: "Unknown") to getPresbyteryMetrics(id)
00065:             }
00066:             "region" -> {
00067:                 val r = regionRepo.findById(id).orElse(null)
00068:                 (r?.name ?: "Unknown") to getRegionMetrics(id)
00069:             }
00070:             else -> ("National") to getNationalMetrics()
00071:         }
00072:         return DrillDownMetrics(level, id, name, metrics, getTrends(id))
00073:     }
00074: 
00075:     // Aggregation helpers (same as before)
00076:     fun getParishMetrics(parishId: String): DashboardMetrics {
00077:         val congregations = congregationRepo.findByParishId(parishId)
00078:         return aggregate(congregations.map { getCongregationMetrics(it.id) })
00079:     }
00080:     fun getPresbyteryMetrics(presbyteryId: String): DashboardMetrics {
00081:         val parishes = parishRepo.findByPresbyteryId(presbyteryId)
00082:         return aggregate(parishes.map { getParishMetrics(it.id) })
00083:     }
00084:     fun getRegionMetrics(regionId: String): DashboardMetrics {
00085:         val presbyteries = presbyteryRepo.findByRegionId(regionId)
00086:         return aggregate(presbyteries.map { getPresbyteryMetrics(it.id) })
00087:     }
00088:     fun getNationalMetrics(): DashboardMetrics {
00089:         val regions = regionRepo.findAll()
00090:         return aggregate(regions.map { getRegionMetrics(it.id) })
00091:     }
00092: 
00093:     private fun aggregate(metrics: List<DashboardMetrics>): DashboardMetrics {
00094:         if (metrics.isEmpty()) return DashboardMetrics(0, 0, 0.0, java.math.BigDecimal.ZERO, 0, 0)
00095:         var totalMembers = 0L; var totalGiving = java.math.BigDecimal.ZERO
00096:         var ministries = 0; var events = 0; var attendanceSum = 0.0
00097:         metrics.forEach {
00098:             totalMembers += it.totalMembers
00099:             totalGiving = totalGiving.add(it.totalGiving)
00100:             ministries += it.activeMinistries
00101:             events += it.upcomingEvents
00102:             attendanceSum += it.attendanceRate
00103:         }
00104:         return DashboardMetrics(totalMembers, totalMembers, attendanceSum / metrics.size, totalGiving, ministries, events)
00105:     }
00106: }

FILE: .\src\main\kotlin\ke\pcea\connect\modules\attendance\application\AttendanceService.kt
============================================================
00001: package ke.pcea.connect.modules.attendance.application
00002: import ke.pcea.connect.modules.attendance.domain.*
00003: import ke.pcea.connect.modules.attendance.infrastructure.*
00004: import ke.pcea.connect.shared.api.BusinessRuleException
00005: import org.springframework.stereotype.Service
00006: import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional
00007: import java.time.LocalDate
00008: import java.time.LocalDateTime
00009: 
00010: @Service
00011: @Transactional
00012: class AttendanceService(private val repo: AttendanceRepository) {
00013: 
00014:     fun markAttendance(userId: String, type: AttendanceType, referenceId: String, congregationId: String, date: LocalDate?): AttendanceRecord {
00015:         val d = date ?: LocalDate.now()
00016:         // Check if already recorded for that user+date+type
00017:         val existing = repo.findByUserIdAndDate(userId, d).find { it.type == type && it.referenceId == referenceId }
00018:         if (existing != null) throw BusinessRuleException("Attendance already recorded for this session")
00019:         val record = AttendanceRecord(userId = userId, type = type, referenceId = referenceId, date = d,
00020:             checkInTime = LocalDateTime.now(), congregationId = congregationId)
00021:         return repo.save(record)
00022:     }
00023: 
00024:     fun checkIn(recordId: String): AttendanceRecord {
00025:         val record = repo.findById(recordId).orElseThrow { BusinessRuleException("Record not found") }
00026:         record.checkInTime = LocalDateTime.now()
00027:         record.status = "PRESENT"
00028:         return repo.save(record)
00029:     }
00030: 
00031:     fun checkout(recordId: String): AttendanceRecord {
00032:         val record = repo.findById(recordId).orElseThrow { BusinessRuleException("Record not found") }
00033:         record.checkOutTime = LocalDateTime.now()
00034:         return repo.save(record)
00035:     }
00036: 
00037:     fun getAttendanceByUser(userId: String) = repo.findByUserId(userId)
00038:     fun getAttendanceByCongregation(congregationId: String, date: LocalDate?) =
00039:         repo.findByCongregationIdAndDate(congregationId, date ?: LocalDate.now())
00040: 
00041:     // Offline sync: accept a batch of records (placeholder for mobile sync)
00042:     fun syncOfflineRecords(records: List<AttendanceRecord>): List<AttendanceRecord> {
00043:         return records.map { repo.save(it) }
00044:     }
00045: }

FILE: .\src\main\kotlin\ke\pcea\connect\modules\bible\application\BibleService.kt

00001: package ke.pcea.connect.modules.bible.application
00002: import ke.pcea.connect.modules.bible.domain.*
00003: import ke.pcea.connect.modules.bible.infrastructure.*
00004: import ke.pcea.connect.shared.api.BusinessRuleException
00005: import org.springframework.stereotype.Service
00006: import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional
00007: import java.time.LocalDate
00008: 
00009: @Service
00010: @Transactional
00011: class BibleService(
00012:     private val bookRepo: BibleBookRepository,
00013:     private val verseRepo: BibleVerseRepository,
00014:     private val bookmarkRepo: BibleBookmarkRepository,
00015:     private val highlightRepo: BibleHighlightRepository,
00016:     private val noteRepo: BibleNoteRepository,
00017:     private val planRepo: BibleReadingPlanRepository,
00018:     private val planDayRepo: BibleReadingPlanDayRepository,
00019:     private val progressRepo: BibleUserReadingProgressRepository,
00020:     private val devotionalRepo: BibleDevotionalRepository,
00021:     private val streakRepo: BibleReadingStreakRepository
00022: ) {
00023:     fun getBooks(testament: String?) = testament?.let { bookRepo.findByTestament(it) } ?: bookRepo.findAll()
00024: 
00025:     // Bulletproof: if translation is null or blank, return all verses for that chapter
00026:     fun getVerses(bookId: String, chapter: Int, translation: String? = null): List<BibleVerse> {
00027:         val all = verseRepo.findByBookIdAndChapter(bookId, chapter)
00028:         return if (translation.isNullOrBlank()) all else all.filter { it.translation == translation }
00029:     }
00030: 
00031:     fun getParallelVerses(bookId: String, chapter: Int, verse: Int): List<BibleVerse> =
00032:         verseRepo.findByBookIdAndChapterAndVerse(bookId, chapter, verse)
00033: 
00034:     fun getVerse(bookId: String, chapter: Int, verse: Int, translation: String? = null): BibleVerse? {
00035:         val verses = verseRepo.findByBookIdAndChapterAndVerse(bookId, chapter, verse)
00036:         return if (translation != null) verses.find { it.translation == translation } else verses.firstOrNull()
00037:     }
00038: 
00039:     fun searchVerses(keyword: String, translation: String = "KJV") =
00040:         verseRepo.findByTranslation(translation).filter { it.text.contains(keyword, ignoreCase = true) }
00041: 
00042:     fun addBookmark(userId: String, bookId: String, chapter: Int, verse: Int, label: String) =
00043:         bookmarkRepo.save(BibleBookmark(userId = userId, bookId = bookId, chapter = chapter, verse = verse, label = label))
00044:     fun removeBookmark(userId: String, bookId: String, chapter: Int, verse: Int) =
00045:         bookmarkRepo.deleteByUserIdAndBookIdAndChapterAndVerse(userId, bookId, chapter, verse)
00046:     fun getBookmarks(userId: String) = bookmarkRepo.findByUserId(userId)
00047: 
00048:     fun addHighlight(userId: String, verseId: String, color: String) =
00049:         highlightRepo.save(BibleHighlight(userId = userId, verseId = verseId, color = color))
00050:     fun removeHighlight(userId: String, verseId: String) =
00051:         highlightRepo.deleteByUserIdAndVerseId(userId, verseId)
00052:     fun getHighlights(userId: String) = highlightRepo.findByUserId(userId)
00053: 
00054:     fun addNote(userId: String, verseId: String, content: String) =
00055:         noteRepo.save(BibleNote(userId = userId, verseId = verseId, content = content))
00056:     fun getNotes(userId: String, verseId: String) = noteRepo.findByUserIdAndVerseId(userId, verseId)
00057: 
00058:     fun getPlans() = planRepo.findAll()
00059:     fun getPlanDays(planId: String) = planDayRepo.findByPlanIdOrderByDayNumber(planId)
00060:     fun startPlan(userId: String, planId: String): BibleUserReadingProgress {
00061:         val existing = progressRepo.findByUserIdAndPlanId(userId, planId)
00062:         if (existing != null) return existing
00063:         return progressRepo.save(BibleUserReadingProgress(userId = userId, planId = planId))
00064:     }
00065:     fun getProgress(userId: String, planId: String) = progressRepo.findByUserIdAndPlanId(userId, planId)
00066:     fun completeDay(userId: String, planId: String, day: Int): BibleUserReadingProgress {
00067:         val progress = progressRepo.findByUserIdAndPlanId(userId, planId)
00068:             ?: throw BusinessRuleException("Plan not started")
00069:         progress.currentDay = day
00070:         return progressRepo.save(progress)
00071:     }
00072: 
00073:     fun getDailyDevotional(date: LocalDate = LocalDate.now()) =
00074:         devotionalRepo.findByDate(date) ?: throw BusinessRuleException("No devotional for today")
00075: 
00076:     fun recordReading(userId: String) {
00077:         val today = LocalDate.now()
00078:         if (streakRepo.findByUserIdAndDate(userId, today) == null) {
00079:             streakRepo.save(BibleReadingStreak(userId = userId, date = today))
00080:         }
00081:     }
00082: 
00083:     fun getCurrentStreak(userId: String): Long {
00084:         val today = LocalDate.now()
00085:         var date = today
00086:         var count = 0L
00087:         while (streakRepo.findByUserIdAndDate(userId, date) != null) {
00088:             count++
00089:             date = date.minusDays(1)
00090:         }
00091:         return count
00092:     }
00093: }

00001: package ke.pcea.connect.modules.church.application
00002: import ke.pcea.connect.modules.church.domain.*
00003: import ke.pcea.connect.modules.church.infrastructure.*
00004: import ke.pcea.connect.shared.api.BusinessRuleException
00005: import org.springframework.stereotype.Service
00006: import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional
00007: 
00008: @Service
00009: @Transactional
00010: class ChurchStructureService(
00011:     private val regionRepo: RegionRepository,
00012:     private val presbyteryRepo: PresbyteryRepository,
00013:     private val parishRepo: ParishRepository,
00014:     private val congregationRepo: CongregationRepository,
00015:     private val gaRepo: GeneralAssemblyRepository
00016: ) {
00017:     fun getAllRegions() = regionRepo.findAll()
00018:     fun createRegion(region: Region) = regionRepo.save(region)
00019:     fun getRegion(id: String) = regionRepo.findById(id).orElseThrow { BusinessRuleException("Region not found") }
00020: 
00021:     fun getPresbyteriesByRegion(regionId: String) = presbyteryRepo.findAll().filter { it.region?.id == regionId }
00022:     fun createPresbytery(name: String, regionId: String): Presbytery {
00023:         val region = regionRepo.findById(regionId).orElseThrow { BusinessRuleException("Region not found") }
00024:         return presbyteryRepo.save(Presbytery(name = name, region = region))
00025:     }
00026:     fun getPresbytery(id: String) = presbyteryRepo.findById(id).orElseThrow { BusinessRuleException("Presbytery not found") }
00027: 
00028:     fun getParishesByPresbytery(presbyteryId: String) = parishRepo.findAll().filter { it.presbytery?.id == presbyteryId }

00001: package ke.pcea.connect.modules.communication.application
00002: import ke.pcea.connect.modules.communication.domain.*
00003: import ke.pcea.connect.modules.communication.infrastructure.*
00004: import ke.pcea.connect.shared.api.BusinessRuleException
00005: import org.springframework.stereotype.Service
00006: import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional
00007: 
00008: @Service
00009: @Transactional
00010: class CommunicationService(
00011:     private val announcementRepo: AnnouncementRepository,
00012:     private val prayerFeedRepo: PrayerFeedRepository,
00013:     private val templateRepo: NotificationTemplateRepository
00014: ) {
00015:     fun createAnnouncement(title: String, content: String, type: AnnouncementType, senderId: String, targetScope: String): Announcement {
00016:         return announcementRepo.save(Announcement(title = title, content = content, type = type, senderId = senderId, targetScope = targetScope))
00017:     }
00018: 
00019:     fun getAnnouncementsForUser(userScopes: List<String>): List<Announcement> {
00020:         return announcementRepo.findAll().filter { ann ->
00021:             userScopes.any { scope -> ann.targetScope.contains(scope) } || ann.targetScope == "all"
00022:         }
00023:     }
00024: 
00025:     fun getAllAnnouncements() = announcementRepo.findAll()
00026: 
00027:     fun postPrayer(userId: String, request: String, isAnonymous: Boolean): PrayerFeedItem {
00028:         return prayerFeedRepo.save(PrayerFeedItem(userId = userId, request = request, isAnonymous = isAnonymous))
00029:     }
00030: 
00031:     fun prayForItem(itemId: String): PrayerFeedItem {
00032:         val item = prayerFeedRepo.findById(itemId).orElseThrow { BusinessRuleException("Prayer not found") }
00033:         item.prayerCount += 1
00034:         return prayerFeedRepo.save(item)
00035:     }
00036: 
00037:     fun getPrayerFeed() = prayerFeedRepo.findAllByOrderByCreatedAtDesc()
00038: 
00039:     fun createTemplate(name: String, title: String, body: String, channel: NotificationChannel): NotificationTemplate {
00040:         return templateRepo.save(NotificationTemplate(name = name, title = title, body = body, channel = channel))
00041:     }
00042: 
00043:     fun getTemplates() = templateRepo.findAll()
00044: }

FILE: .\src\main\kotlin\ke\pcea\connect\modules\communication\infrastructure\AfricasTalkingService.kt
============================================================
00001: package ke.pcea.connect.modules.communication.infrastructure
00002: 
00003: import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value
00004: import org.springframework.http.*
00005: import org.springframework.stereotype.Service
00006: import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate
00007: 
00008: @Service
00009: class AfricasTalkingService(
00010:     @Value("\${africastalking.api-key}") private val apiKey: String,
00011:     @Value("\${africastalking.username}") private val username: String
00012: ) {
00013:     private val restTemplate = RestTemplate()
00014: 
00015:     fun sendSms(phoneNumber: String, message: String): Boolean {
00016:         try {
00017:             val headers = HttpHeaders().apply {
00018:                 contentType = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON
00019:                 set("apiKey", apiKey)
00020:             }
00021:             val body = mapOf("username" to username, "to" to phoneNumber, "message" to message)
00022:             restTemplate.postForEntity(
00023:                 "https://api.africastalking.com/version1/messaging",
00024:                 HttpEntity(body, headers),
00025:                 String::class.java
00026:             )
00027:             return true
00028:         } catch (e: Exception) {
00029:             return false
00030:         }
00031:     }
00032: 
00033:     fun handleUssd(sessionId: String, phoneNumber: String, text: String): String {
00034:         // Simple USSD menu for giving, prayer, announcements
00035:         return when {
00036:             text.isEmpty() -> "CON Welcome to PCEA Connect\n1. Give\n2. Prayer Request\n3. Announcements"
00037:             text == "1" -> "CON Enter amount in KES:"
00038:             text.startsWith("1*") -> "END Thank you! You will receive an M-Pesa prompt."
00039:             text == "2" -> "CON Enter your prayer request:"
00040:             text.startsWith("2*") -> "END Your prayer request has been received."
00041:             text == "3" -> "END Latest: Join us Sunday at 10 AM."
00042:             else -> "END Invalid choice. Goodbye."
00043:         }
00044:     }
00045: }

00027:     }

00014: class CongregationOpsService(

00017:     private val visitorRepo: VisitorRepository,
00018:     private val congregationRepo: CongregationRepository,
00019:     private val userRepo: UserRepository,
00020:     private val attendanceRepo: AttendanceRepository
00021: ) {
00022:     // Small Groups
00023:     fun createSmallGroup(name: String, description: String, congregationId: String, leaderId: String,
00024:                          meetingDay: String, meetingTime: String, location: String): SmallGroup {
00025:         return smallGroupRepo.save(SmallGroup(name = name, description = description, congregationId = congregationId,
00026:             leaderId = leaderId, meetingDay = meetingDay, meetingTime = meetingTime, location = location))
00027:     }
00028:     fun getSmallGroups(congregationId: String) = smallGroupRepo.findByCongregationId(congregationId)
00029:

00034:             chairpersonId = chairpersonId, meetingFrequency = meetingFrequency))
00035:     }

00037: 
00038:     // Visitors
00039:     fun registerVisitor(fullName: String, phone: String, email: String, purpose: String, congregationId: String): Visitor {
00040:         return visitorRepo.save(Visitor(fullName = fullName, phone = phone, email = email, purpose = purpose, congregationId = congregationId))
00041:     }
00042:     fun getVisitors(congregationId: String) = visitorRepo.findByCongregationId(congregationId)
00043:     fun markVisitorFollowedUp(visitorId: String): Visitor {
00044:         val visitor = visitorRepo.findById(visitorId).orElseThrow { BusinessRuleException("Visitor not found") }
00045:         visitor.followedUp = true
00046:         return visitorRepo.save(visitor)
00047:     }
00048: 
00049:     // Admin Dashboard Summary
00050:     fun getAdminDashboard(congregationId: String): Map<String, Any> {
00051:         val totalMembers = userRepo.countByCongregationId(congregationId)
00052:         val groupsCount = smallGroupRepo.findByCongregationId(congregationId).size
00053:         val committeesCount = committeeRepo.findByCongregationId(congregationId).size
00054:         val visitorsThisMonth = visitorRepo.findByCongregationId(congregationId)
00055:             .count { it.visitDate.month == LocalDateTime.now().month }
00056:         val attendanceToday = attendanceRepo.countByCongregationIdAndDate(congregationId, java.time.LocalDate.now())
00057:         return mapOf(
00058:             "totalMembers" to totalMembers,
00059:             "smallGroups" to groupsCount,
00060:             "committees" to committeesCount,
00061:             "visitorsThisMonth" to visitorsThisMonth,
00062:             "attendanceToday" to attendanceToday
00063:         )
00064:     }
00065: }

FILE: .\src\main\kotlin\ke\pcea\connect\modules\events\application\EventService.kt
============================================================
00001: package ke.pcea.connect.modules.events.application
00002: import ke.pcea.connect.modules.events.domain.*
00003: import ke.pcea.connect.modules.events.infrastructure.*
00004: import ke.pcea.connect.shared.api.BusinessRuleException
00005: import org.springframework.stereotype.Service
00006: import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional
00007: import java.time.LocalDateTime
00008: import java.util.UUID
00009: 
00010: @Service
00011: @Transactional
00012: class EventService(
00013:     private val eventRepo: EventRepository,
00014:     private val regRepo: EventRegistrationRepository
00015: ) {
00016:     fun createEvent(title: String, description: String, type: EventType, location: String, organizerId: String,
00017:                     startTime: LocalDateTime, endTime: LocalDateTime?, maxAttendees: Int,
00018:                     requiresRegistration: Boolean, qrCheckInEnabled: Boolean,
00019:                     recurrenceType: RecurrenceType, recurrenceEndDate: LocalDateTime?): Event {
00020:         val event = Event(title = title, description = description, type = type, location = location,
00021:             organizerId = organizerId, startTime = startTime, endTime = endTime, maxAttendees = maxAttendees,
00022:             requiresRegistration = requiresRegistration, qrCheckInEnabled = qrCheckInEnabled,
00023:             recurrenceType = recurrenceType, recurrenceEndDate = recurrenceEndDate)
00024:         return eventRepo.save(event)
00025:     }
00026: 
00027:     fun getAllEvents(): List<Event> = eventRepo.findAllByOrderByStartTimeAsc()
00028:     fun getPublishedEvents(): List<Event> = eventRepo.findByStatus(EventStatus.PUBLISHED)
00029:     fun getEvent(id: String): Event = eventRepo.findById(id).orElseThrow { BusinessRuleException("Event not found") }
00030: 
00031:     fun publishEvent(eventId: String): Event {
00032:         val event = getEvent(eventId)
00033:         event.status = EventStatus.PUBLISHED
00034:         return eventRepo.save(event)
00035:     }
00036: 
00037:     fun registerForEvent(eventId: String, userId: String): EventRegistration {
00038:         val event = getEvent(eventId)
00039:         if (event.status != EventStatus.PUBLISHED) throw BusinessRuleException("Event not open for registration")
00040:         if (event.maxAttendees > 0) {
00041:             val currentCount = regRepo.countByEventIdAndStatus(eventId, RegistrationStatus.REGISTERED)
00042:             if (currentCount >= event.maxAttendees) throw BusinessRuleException("Event is full")
00043:         }
00044:         val existing = regRepo.findByEventIdAndUserId(eventId, userId)
00045:         if (existing != null) throw BusinessRuleException("Already registered")
00046:         val ticketCode = UUID.randomUUID().toString().take(8).uppercase()
00047:         return regRepo.save(EventRegistration(event = event, userId = userId, ticketCode = ticketCode))
00048:     }
00049: 
00050:     fun checkIn(ticketCode: String): EventRegistration {
00051:         val reg = regRepo.findAll().find { it.ticketCode == ticketCode }
00052:             ?: throw BusinessRuleException("Invalid ticket code")
00053:         reg.status = RegistrationStatus.ATTENDED
00054:         reg.attendedAt = LocalDateTime.now()
00055:         return regRepo.save(reg)
00056:     }
00057: 
00058:     fun getRegistrationsForEvent(eventId: String) = regRepo.findByEventId(eventId)
00059: }

00001: package ke.pcea.connect.modules.events.domain

00005: enum class EventType { SUNDAY_SERVICE, FELLOWSHIP, BRIGADE, GUILD, CONFERENCE, TRAINING, OTHER }

00007: enum class RegistrationStatus { REGISTERED, ATTENDED, CANCELLED }
00008: enum class RecurrenceType { NONE, DAILY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY, YEARLY }
00009: 
00010: @Entity @Table(name = "events")
00011: data class Event(
00012:     @Id @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.UUID) val id: String = "",
00013:     val title: String = "",

00015:     @Enumerated(EnumType.STRING) val type: EventType = EventType.OTHER,
00016:     val location: String = "",
00017:     val organizerId: String = "",
00018:     val startTime: LocalDateTime = LocalDateTime.now(),
00019:     val endTime: LocalDateTime? = null,
00020:     val maxAttendees: Int = 0,
00021:     val requiresRegistration: Boolean = false,
00022:     val qrCheckInEnabled: Boolean = false,
00023:     @Enumerated(EnumType.STRING) var status: EventStatus = EventStatus.DRAFT,
00024:     val createdAt: LocalDateTime = LocalDateTime.now(),
00025:     // Recurrence
00026:     @Enumerated(EnumType.STRING) val recurrenceType: RecurrenceType = RecurrenceType.NONE,
00027:     val recurrenceEndDate: LocalDateTime? = null,
00028:     val parentEventId: String? = null   // for recurring instances
00029: )
00030: 
00031: @Entity @Table(name = "event_registrations")
00032: data class EventRegistration(
00033:     @Id @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.UUID) val id: String = "",
00034:     @ManyToOne(fetch = FetchType.LAZY) @JoinColumn(name = "event_id") val event: Event? = null,
00035:     val userId: String = "",
00036:     @Enumerated(EnumType.STRING) var status: RegistrationStatus = RegistrationStatus.REGISTERED,
00037:     val registeredAt: LocalDateTime = LocalDateTime.now(),

FILE: .\src\main\kotlin\ke\pcea\connect\modules\feed\application\FeedService.kt
============================================================
00001: package ke.pcea.connect.modules.feed.application
00002: import ke.pcea.connect.modules.feed.domain.*
00003: import ke.pcea.connect.modules.feed.infrastructure.*
00004: import ke.pcea.connect.modules.identity.infrastructure.UserRepository
00005: import ke.pcea.connect.shared.api.BusinessRuleException
00006: import org.springframework.stereotype.Service
00007: import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional
00008: 
00009: @Service
00010: @Transactional
00011: class FeedService(
00012:     private val postRepo: FeedPostRepository,
00013:     private val reactionRepo: FeedReactionRepository,
00014:     private val commentRepo: FeedCommentRepository,
00015:     private val userRepo: UserRepository
00016: ) {
00017:     fun createPost(authorId: String, content: String, type: PostType, mediaUrl: String, congregationId: String, ministryId: String?): FeedPost {
00018:         val post = FeedPost(authorId = authorId, content = content, type = type,
00019:             mediaUrl = mediaUrl, congregationId = congregationId, ministryId = ministryId)
00020:         return postRepo.save(post)
00021:     }
00022: 
00023:     fun getPosts(congregationId: String?, ministryId: String?): List<FeedPost> {
00024:         return when {
00025:             ministryId != null -> postRepo.findByMinistryIdOrderByCreatedAtDesc(ministryId)
00026:             congregationId != null -> postRepo.findByCongregationIdOrderByCreatedAtDesc(congregationId)
00027:             else -> postRepo.findAllByOrderByCreatedAtDesc()
00028:         }
00029:     }
00030: 
00031:     fun addReaction(postId: String, userId: String, type: ReactionType): FeedPost {
00032:         val post = postRepo.findById(postId).orElseThrow { BusinessRuleException("Post not found") }
00033:         val existing = reactionRepo.findByPostIdAndUserId(postId, userId)
00034:         if (existing != null) throw BusinessRuleException("Already reacted")
00035:         reactionRepo.save(FeedReaction(postId = postId, userId = userId, type = type))
00036:         // update counts
00037:         when (type) {
00038:             ReactionType.LIKE -> post.likes = reactionRepo.countByPostIdAndType(postId, ReactionType.LIKE).toInt()
00039:             ReactionType.LOVE -> post.loves = reactionRepo.countByPostIdAndType(postId, ReactionType.LOVE).toInt()
00040:             ReactionType.PRAY -> post.prays = reactionRepo.countByPostIdAndType(postId, ReactionType.PRAY).toInt()
00041:             ReactionType.AMEN -> post.amens = reactionRepo.countByPostIdAndType(postId, ReactionType.AMEN).toInt()
00042:         }
00043:         return postRepo.save(post)
00044:     }
00045: 
00046:     fun addComment(postId: String, userId: String, content: String): FeedComment {
00047:         val comment = FeedComment(postId = postId, userId = userId, content = content)
00048:         return commentRepo.save(comment)
00049:     }
00050: 
00051:     fun getComments(postId: String) = commentRepo.findByPostIdOrderByCreatedAtAsc(postId)
00052: }

00001: package ke.pcea.connect.modules.giving.api.controller
00002: import ke.pcea.connect.modules.giving.api.dto.*
00003: import ke.pcea.connect.modules.giving.application.GivingService
00004: import ke.pcea.connect.modules.giving.infrastructure.MpesaDarajaService
00005: import ke.pcea.connect.shared.api.ApiResponse
00006: import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity
00007: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*
00008: 
00009: @RestController
00010: @RequestMapping("/api/giving")
00011: class GivingController(
00012:     private val service: GivingService,
00013:     private val mpesaService: MpesaDarajaService
00014: ) {
00015:     @PostMapping("/contribute")
00016:     fun contribute(@RequestBody req: ContributionRequest): ResponseEntity<ApiResponse<ContributionResponse>> {
00017:         val c = service.recordContribution(req.userId, req.type, req.amount, req.method, req.phoneNumber, req.description, req.congregationId)
00018:         if (req.method.name == "MPESA" && req.phoneNumber.isNotBlank()) {
00019:             try {
00020:                 val stkResponse = mpesaService.stkPush(req.phoneNumber, req.amount, c.id, req.description)
00021:                 if (stkResponse.CheckoutRequestID != null) {
00022:                     c.transactionRef = stkResponse.CheckoutRequestID
00023:                     service.updateContribution(c)
00024:                 }
00025:             } catch (e: Exception) { /* STK push failed – contribution still saved as PENDING */ }
00026:         }
00027:         return ResponseEntity.ok(ApiResponse.success(ContributionResponse(c.id, c.userId, c.type.name, c.amount, c.method.name, c.status.name, c.transactionRef, c.createdAt.toString())))
00028:     }
00029: 
00030:     @PostMapping("/confirm-payment")
00031:     fun confirmPayment(@RequestBody req: PaymentConfirmationRequest): ResponseEntity<ApiResponse<ContributionResponse>> {
00032:         val c = service.confirmPayment(req.contributionId, req.mpesaCode)
00033:         return ResponseEntity.ok(ApiResponse.success(ContributionResponse(c.id, c.userId, c.type.name, c.amount, c.method.name, c.status.name, c.transactionRef, c.createdAt.toString())))
00034:     }
00035: 
00036:     @GetMapping("/contributions/{userId}")
00037:     fun getUserContributions(@PathVariable userId: String) = ResponseEntity.ok(ApiResponse.success(
00038:         service.getUserContributions(userId).map { ContributionResponse(it.id, it.userId, it.type.name, it.amount, it.method.name, it.status.name, it.transactionRef, it.createdAt.toString()) }
00039:     ))
00040: 
00041:     @GetMapping("/statement/{userId}")
00042:     fun getStatement(@PathVariable userId: String, @RequestParam(required = false) year: Int?) = ResponseEntity.ok(ApiResponse.success(
00043:         service.getStatement(userId, year).let { StatementResponse(it.userId, it.statementYear, it.totalAmount, it.titheAmount, it.offeringAmount, it.donationAmount) }
00044:     ))
00045: }

FILE: .\src\main\kotlin\ke\pcea\connect\modules\giving\api\controller\MpesaCallbackController.kt
============================================================
00001: package ke.pcea.connect.modules.giving.api.controller
00002: 
00003: import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper
00004: import ke.pcea.connect.modules.giving.domain.*
00005: import ke.pcea.connect.modules.giving.infrastructure.*
00006: import ke.pcea.connect.shared.api.ApiResponse
00007: import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value
00008: import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity
00009: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*
00010: import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional
00011: 
00012: @RestController
00013: @RequestMapping("/api/giving")
00014: class MpesaCallbackController(
00015:     private val contributionRepo: ContributionRepository,
00016:     private val statementRepo: ContributionStatementRepository,
00017:     private val objectMapper: ObjectMapper,
00018:     @Value("\${mpesa.callback-secret}") private val expectedSecret: String
00019: ) {
00020:     data class StkCallbackBody(
00021:         val Body: Body?,
00022:         val stkCallback: StkCallback?
00023:     )
00024:     data class Body(val stkCallback: StkCallback?)
00025:     data class StkCallback(
00026:         val MerchantRequestID: String?,
00027:         val CheckoutRequestID: String?,
00028:         val ResultCode: Int?,
00029:         val ResultDesc: String?,
00030:         val CallbackMetadata: CallbackMetadata?
00031:     )
00032:     data class CallbackMetadata(val Item: List<Item>?)
00033:     data class Item(val Name: String?, val Value: Any?)
00034: 
00035:     // Path now carries the shared secret (see SecurityConfig â€” this is the one route permitted
00036:     // through without a JWT, since Safaricom's servers can't authenticate). Anyone hitting the
00037:     // bare /mpesa-callback path without the correct secret gets a 401 from Spring Security
00038:     // before this method ever runs; this check is a second, defense-in-depth guard.
00039:     @PostMapping("/mpesa-callback/{secret}")
00040:     @Transactional
00041:     fun handleCallback(@PathVariable secret: String, @RequestBody rawBody: String): ResponseEntity<ApiResponse<String>> {
00042:         if (secret != expectedSecret) {
00043:             return ResponseEntity.status(404).body(ApiResponse.error<String>("Not found"))
00044:         }
00045: 
00046:         val json = objectMapper.readTree(rawBody)
00047:         val resultCode = json.at("/Body/stkCallback/ResultCode").asInt(1)
00048:         val checkoutRequestId = json.at("/Body/stkCallback/CheckoutRequestID").asText("")
00049: 
00050:         if (resultCode == 0) {
00051:             val contribution = contributionRepo.findAll()
00052:                 .firstOrNull { it.transactionRef == checkoutRequestId }
00053:             if (contribution != null && contribution.status != PaymentStatus.COMPLETED) {
00054:                 // Idempotency: Safaricom can and does retry callbacks. Without this guard a
00055:                 // retried callback would re-run below and could double-count in edge cases
00056:                 // depending on future changes to this method â€” guard now while it's simple.
00057:                 contribution.status = PaymentStatus.COMPLETED
00058:                 contributionRepo.save(contribution)
00059: 
00060:                 val year = java.time.LocalDateTime.now().year
00061:                 val statement = statementRepo.findByUserIdAndStatementYear(contribution.userId, year)
00062:                     ?: ContributionStatement(userId = contribution.userId, statementYear = year)
00063:                 statement.totalAmount = contributionRepo.findByUserId(contribution.userId)
00064:                     .filter { it.status == PaymentStatus.COMPLETED && it.createdAt.year == year }
00065:                     .fold(java.math.BigDecimal.ZERO) { acc, c -> acc.add(c.amount) }
00066:                 statementRepo.save(statement)
00067:             }
00068:         }
00069:         return ResponseEntity.ok(ApiResponse.success("Callback processed"))
00070:     }
00071: }

FILE: .\src\main\kotlin\ke\pcea\connect\modules\giving\application\GivingService.kt
============================================================
00001: package ke.pcea.connect.modules.giving.application
00002: import ke.pcea.connect.modules.giving.domain.*
00003: import ke.pcea.connect.modules.giving.infrastructure.*
00004: import ke.pcea.connect.shared.api.BusinessRuleException
00005: import org.springframework.stereotype.Service
00006: import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional
00007: import java.time.LocalDateTime
00008: 
00009: @Service
00010: @Transactional
00011: class GivingService(
00012:     private val contributionRepo: ContributionRepository,
00013:     private val statementRepo: ContributionStatementRepository
00014: ) {
00015:     fun recordContribution(userId: String, type: ContributionType, amount: java.math.BigDecimal,
00016:                            method: PaymentMethod, phoneNumber: String, description: String, congregationId: String): Contribution {
00017:         val contribution = Contribution(userId = userId, type = type, amount = amount, method = method,
00018:             phoneNumber = phoneNumber, description = description, congregationId = congregationId, status = PaymentStatus.PENDING)
00019:         return contributionRepo.save(contribution)
00020:     }
00021: 
00022:     fun updateContribution(contribution: Contribution) = contributionRepo.save(contribution)
00023: 
00024:     fun confirmPayment(contributionId: String, mpesaCode: String): Contribution {
00025:         val contribution = contributionRepo.findById(contributionId)
00026:             .orElseThrow { BusinessRuleException("Contribution not found") }
00027:         contribution.status = PaymentStatus.COMPLETED
00028:         contribution.transactionRef = mpesaCode
00029:         val saved = contributionRepo.save(contribution)
00030:         updateStatement(saved.userId)
00031:         return saved
00032:     }
00033: 
00034:     fun getUserContributions(userId: String) = contributionRepo.findByUserId(userId)
00035:     fun getCongregationContributions(congregationId: String) = contributionRepo.findByCongregationId(congregationId)
00036: 
00037:     fun getStatement(userId: String, year: Int?): ContributionStatement {
00038:         val y = year ?: LocalDateTime.now().year
00039:         val statement = statementRepo.findByUserIdAndStatementYear(userId, y)
00040:         if (statement != null) return statement
00041:         return statementRepo.save(ContributionStatement(userId = userId, statementYear = y))
00042:     }
00043: 
00044:     private fun updateStatement(userId: String) {
00045:         val year = LocalDateTime.now().year
00046:         val allContributions = contributionRepo.findByUserId(userId)
00047:             .filter { it.status == PaymentStatus.COMPLETED && it.createdAt.year == year }
00048:         var statement = statementRepo.findByUserIdAndStatementYear(userId, year)
00049:         if (statement == null) {
00050:             statement = ContributionStatement(userId = userId, statementYear = year)
00051:         }
00052:         statement.totalAmount = allContributions.fold(java.math.BigDecimal.ZERO) { acc, c -> acc.add(c.amount) }
00053:         statement.titheAmount = allContributions.filter { it.type == ContributionType.TITHE }.fold(java.math.BigDecimal.ZERO) { acc, c -> acc.add(c.amount) }
00054:         statement.offeringAmount = allContributions.filter { it.type == ContributionType.OFFERING }.fold(java.math.BigDecimal.ZERO) { acc, c -> acc.add(c.amount) }
00055:         statement.donationAmount = allContributions.filter { it.type == ContributionType.DONATION || it.type == ContributionType.PROJECT }.fold(java.math.BigDecimal.ZERO) { acc, c -> acc.add(c.amount) }
00056:         statementRepo.save(statement)
00057:     }
00058: }

FILE: .\src\main\kotlin\ke\pcea\connect\modules\giving\infrastructure\MpesaDarajaService.kt
============================================================
00001: package ke.pcea.connect.modules.giving.infrastructure
00002: 
00003: import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value
00004: import org.springframework.http.*
00005: import org.springframework.stereotype.Service
00006: import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate
00007: import java.util.Base64
00008: import java.time.LocalDateTime
00009: import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter
00010: 
00011: @Service
00012: class MpesaDarajaService(
00013:     @Value("\${mpesa.consumer-key}") private val consumerKey: String,
00014:     @Value("\${mpesa.consumer-secret}") private val consumerSecret: String,
00015:     @Value("\${mpesa.passkey}") private val passkey: String,
00016:     @Value("\${mpesa.shortcode}") private val shortcode: String,
00017:     @Value("\${mpesa.callback-url}") private val callbackUrl: String
00018: ) {
00019:     private val restTemplate = RestTemplate()
00020: 
00021:     data class StkResponse(val CheckoutRequestID: String?, val ResponseCode: String?, val ResponseDescription: String?)
00022: 
00023:     fun getAccessToken(): String {
00024:         val credentials = "$consumerKey:$consumerSecret"
00025:         val encoded = Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(credentials.toByteArray())
00026:         val headers = HttpHeaders().apply { set("Authorization", "Basic $encoded") }
00027:         val response = restTemplate.exchange(
00028:             "https://sandbox.safaricom.co.ke/oauth/v1/generate?grant_type=client_credentials",
00029:             HttpMethod.GET,
00030:             HttpEntity<String>(headers),
00031:             Map::class.java
00032:         )
00033:         val body = response.body as? Map<*, *>
00034:         return (body?.get("access_token") as? String) ?: ""
00035:     }
00036: 
00037:     fun stkPush(phoneNumber: String, amount: java.math.BigDecimal, accountRef: String, description: String): StkResponse {
00038:         val token = getAccessToken()
00039:         val timestamp = LocalDateTime.now().format(DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("yyyyMMddHHmmss"))
00040:         val password = Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString("$shortcode$passkey$timestamp".toByteArray())
00041: 
00042:         val headers = HttpHeaders().apply {
00043:             contentType = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON
00044:             setBearerAuth(token)
00045:         }
00046: 
00047:         val payload = mapOf<String, Any>(
00048:             "BusinessShortCode" to shortcode,
00049:             "Password" to password,
00050:             "Timestamp" to timestamp,
00051:             "TransactionType" to "CustomerPayBillOnline",
00052:             "Amount" to amount.toPlainString(),
00053:             "PartyA" to phoneNumber.replace("+", "").replace(" ", ""),
00054:             "PartyB" to shortcode,
00055:             "PhoneNumber" to phoneNumber.replace("+", "").replace(" ", ""),
00056:             "CallBackURL" to callbackUrl,
00057:             "AccountReference" to accountRef,
00058:             "TransactionDesc" to description
00059:         )
00060: 
00061:         val response = restTemplate.postForEntity(
00062:             "https://sandbox.safaricom.co.ke/mpesa/stkpush/v1/processrequest",
00063:             HttpEntity(payload, headers),
00064:             Map::class.java
00065:         )
00066: 
00067:         val body = response.body as? Map<*, *>
00068:         return StkResponse(
00069:             CheckoutRequestID = body?.get("CheckoutRequestID") as? String,
00070:             ResponseCode = body?.get("ResponseCode") as? String,
00071:             ResponseDescription = body?.get("ResponseDescription") as? String
00072:         )
00073:     }
00074: }

00001: package ke.pcea.connect.modules.identity.api.controller

00025: @Repository
00026: interface PasswordResetTokenRepository : JpaRepository<PasswordResetToken, String> {
00027:     fun findByToken(token: String): PasswordResetToken?
00028: }
00029: 
00030: @Service
00031: class PasswordResetService(
00032:     private val userRepo: UserRepository,
00033:     private val tokenRepo: PasswordResetTokenRepository,
00034:     private val passwordEncoder: PasswordEncoder
00035: ) {
00036:     @Transactional
00037:     fun createResetToken(email: String): String {
00038:         val user = userRepo.findByEmail(email).orElse(null) ?: return ""
00039:         val token = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
00040:         tokenRepo.save(PasswordResetToken(userId = user.id, token = token))
00041:         return token
00042:     }
00043: 
00044:     @Transactional
00045:     fun resetPassword(token: String, newPassword: String): Boolean {
00046:         val resetToken = tokenRepo.findByToken(token) ?: return false
00047:         if (resetToken.used || resetToken.expiryDate.isBefore(Instant.now())) return false
00048:         val user = userRepo.findById(resetToken.userId).orElse(null) ?: return false
00049:         user.password = passwordEncoder.encode(newPassword)
00050:         userRepo.save(user)
00051:         resetToken.used = true
00052:         tokenRepo.save(resetToken)
00053:         return true
00054:     }
00055: }
00056: 
00057: @RestController
00058: @RequestMapping("/api/auth")
00059: class PasswordResetController(
00060:     private val resetService: PasswordResetService
00061: ) {
00062:     data class ForgotPasswordRequest(val email: String)
00063:     data class ResetPasswordRequest(val token: String, val newPassword: String)
00064: 
00065:     @PostMapping("/forgot-password")
00066:     fun forgotPassword(@RequestBody req: ForgotPasswordRequest): ResponseEntity<ApiResponse<String>> {
00067:         val token = resetService.createResetToken(req.email)
00068:         return ResponseEntity.ok(ApiResponse.success(if (token.isNotEmpty()) "Reset link sent" else "If email exists, reset link sent"))
00069:     }
00070: 
00071:     @PostMapping("/reset-password")
00072:     fun resetPassword(@RequestBody req: ResetPasswordRequest): ResponseEntity<ApiResponse<Any>> {
00073:         val success = resetService.resetPassword(req.token, req.newPassword)
00074:         return if (success) ResponseEntity.ok(ApiResponse.success("Password reset successful"))
00075:         else ResponseEntity.badRequest().body(ApiResponse.error("Invalid or expired token") as ApiResponse<Any>)
00076:     }
00077: }

00001: package ke.pcea.connect.modules.identity.api.controller
00002: 
00003: import ke.pcea.connect.modules.identity.infrastructure.UserRepository
00004: import ke.pcea.connect.shared.api.ApiResponse
00005: import ke.pcea.connect.shared.api.BusinessRuleException
00006: import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity
00007: import org.springframework.security.access.prepost.PreAuthorize
00008: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*
00009: 
00010: // Valid roles for this deployment. Keep in sync with docs/10-Security.md.
00011: val VALID_ROLES = setOf("MEMBER", "ELDER", "CLERK", "TREASURER", "ADMIN", "SUPER_ADMIN")
00012: 
00013: data class AssignRoleRequest(val role: String)
00014: data class UserRolesResponse(val userId: String, val roles: List<String>)
00015: 
00016: @RestController
00017: @RequestMapping("/api/admin/users")
00018: class RoleController(private val userRepo: UserRepository) {
00019: 
00020:     // SUPER_ADMIN only, deliberately narrower than plain ADMIN â€” granting roles (including
00021:     // granting ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN itself) is the highest-privilege action in the system.
00022:     @PreAuthorize("hasRole('SUPER_ADMIN')")
00023:     @PostMapping("/{userId}/roles")
00024:     fun assignRole(@PathVariable userId: String, @RequestBody req: AssignRoleRequest): ResponseEntity<ApiResponse<UserRolesResponse>> {
00025:         if (req.role !in VALID_ROLES) throw BusinessRuleException("Unknown role: ${req.role}")
00026:         val user = userRepo.findById(userId).orElseThrow { BusinessRuleException("User not found") }
00027:         user.roles.add(req.role)
00028:         userRepo.save(user)
00029:         return ResponseEntity.ok(ApiResponse.success(UserRolesResponse(user.id, user.roles.toList())))
00030:     }
00031: 
00032:     @PreAuthorize("hasRole('SUPER_ADMIN')")
00033:     @DeleteMapping("/{userId}/roles/{role}")
00034:     fun removeRole(@PathVariable userId: String, @PathVariable role: String): ResponseEntity<ApiResponse<UserRolesResponse>> {
00035:         val user = userRepo.findById(userId).orElseThrow { BusinessRuleException("User not found") }
00036:         if (role == "SUPER_ADMIN" && user.roles.contains("SUPER_ADMIN") &&
00037:             userRepo.findAll().count { it.roles.contains("SUPER_ADMIN") } <= 1) {
00038:             throw BusinessRuleException("Cannot remove the last SUPER_ADMIN")
00039:         }
00040:         user.roles.remove(role)
00041:         userRepo.save(user)
00042:         return ResponseEntity.ok(ApiResponse.success(UserRolesResponse(user.id, user.roles.toList())))
00043:     }
00044: 
00045:     @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('SUPER_ADMIN', 'ADMIN')")
00046:     @GetMapping("/{userId}/roles")
00047:     fun getRoles(@PathVariable userId: String): ResponseEntity<ApiResponse<UserRolesResponse>> {
00048:         val user = userRepo.findById(userId).orElseThrow { BusinessRuleException("User not found") }
00049:         return ResponseEntity.ok(ApiResponse.success(UserRolesResponse(user.id, user.roles.toList())))
00050:     }
00051: }
