FILE: .\src\main\kotlin\ke\pcea\connect\modules\identity\application\AuthService.kt
============================================================
00001: package ke.pcea.connect.modules.identity.application
00002: import ke.pcea.connect.modules.identity.domain.RefreshToken
00003: import ke.pcea.connect.modules.identity.domain.User
00004: import ke.pcea.connect.modules.identity.infrastructure.RefreshTokenRepository
00005: import ke.pcea.connect.modules.identity.infrastructure.UserRepository
00006: import ke.pcea.connect.shared.api.BusinessRuleException
00007: import org.springframework.security.crypto.password.PasswordEncoder
00008: import org.springframework.stereotype.Service
00009: import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional
00010: import java.time.Instant
00011: 
00012: @Service
00013: @Transactional
00014: class AuthService(
00015:     private val userRepo: UserRepository,
00016:     private val refreshTokenRepo: RefreshTokenRepository,
00017:     private val passwordEncoder: PasswordEncoder,
00018:     private val tokenService: TokenService
00019: ) {
00020:     fun register(email: String, password: String, fullName: String, phone: String): User {
00021:         if (userRepo.findByEmail(email).isPresent) throw BusinessRuleException("Email already registered")
00022:         val roles = if (userRepo.count() == 0L) mutableSetOf("MEMBER", "SUPER_ADMIN") else mutableSetOf("MEMBER")
00023:         val user = User(email = email, password = passwordEncoder.encode(password), fullName = fullName, phone = phone, roles = roles)
00024:         return userRepo.save(user)
00025:     }
00026: 
00027:     fun login(email: String, password: String): LoginResult {
00028:         val user = userRepo.findByEmail(email)
00029:             .orElseThrow { BusinessRuleException("Invalid credentials") }
00030:         if (!passwordEncoder.matches(password, user.password))
00031:             throw BusinessRuleException("Invalid credentials")
00032: 
00033:         val roles = user.roles.toList()
00034:         val accessToken = tokenService.createAccessToken(user.id, roles)
00035:         val refreshTokenStr = tokenService.createRefreshToken(user.id)
00036: 
00037:         // Delete previous refresh tokens for this user and insert the new one
00038:         refreshTokenRepo.deleteByUserId(user.id)
00039:         val refreshToken = RefreshToken(token = refreshTokenStr, userId = user.id, expiryDate = Instant.now().plusSeconds(604800))
00040:         refreshTokenRepo.save(refreshToken)
00041: 
00042:         return LoginResult(accessToken, refreshTokenStr, user.id, user.fullName)
00043:     }
00044: 
00045:     fun refreshAccessToken(refreshToken: String): String {
00046:         val stored = refreshTokenRepo.findByToken(refreshToken)
00047:             ?: throw BusinessRuleException("Invalid refresh token")
00048:         if (stored.expiryDate.isBefore(Instant.now()))
00049:             throw BusinessRuleException("Refresh token expired")
00050:         val user = userRepo.findById(stored.userId).orElseThrow { BusinessRuleException("User not found") }
00051:         return tokenService.createAccessToken(user.id, user.roles.toList())
00052:     }
00053: }
00054: data class LoginResult(val accessToken: String, val refreshToken: String, val userId: String, val fullName: String)

00001: package ke.pcea.connect.modules.livestream.application
00002: import ke.pcea.connect.modules.livestream.domain.*

00008: 
00009: @Service
00010: @Transactional
00011: class LivestreamService(private val repo: LivestreamRepository) {
00012:     fun schedule(title: String, description: String, preacher: String, scriptureRef: String,
00013:                  platform: StreamPlatform, embedUrl: String, thumbnailUrl: String, scheduledAt: LocalDateTime): Livestream {
00014:         val stream = Livestream(title = title, description = description, preacher = preacher,
00015:             scriptureRef = scriptureRef, platform = platform, embedUrl = embedUrl,
00016:             thumbnailUrl = thumbnailUrl, scheduledAt = scheduledAt)
00017:         return repo.save(stream)
00018:     }
00019: 
00020:     fun goLive(streamId: String): Livestream {
00021:         val stream = repo.findById(streamId).orElseThrow { BusinessRuleException("Stream not found") }
00022:         stream.status = StreamStatus.LIVE
00023:         return repo.save(stream)
00024:     }
00025: 
00026:     fun endStream(streamId: String): Livestream {
00027:         val stream = repo.findById(streamId).orElseThrow { BusinessRuleException("Stream not found") }
00028:         stream.status = StreamStatus.ENDED
00029:         stream.endedAt = LocalDateTime.now()
00030:         return repo.save(stream)
00031:     }
00032: 
00033:     fun getUpcoming() = repo.findByStatus(StreamStatus.SCHEDULED).sortedBy { it.scheduledAt }
00034:     fun getLive() = repo.findByStatus(StreamStatus.LIVE)
00035:     fun getAll() = repo.findByOrderByScheduledAtDesc()
00036:     fun getPast() = repo.findByStatus(StreamStatus.ENDED).sortedByDescending { it.endedAt }
00037: }

FILE: .\src\main\kotlin\ke\pcea\connect\modules\media\application\MediaService.kt
============================================================
00001: package ke.pcea.connect.modules.media.application
00002: import ke.pcea.connect.modules.media.domain.*
00003: import ke.pcea.connect.modules.media.infrastructure.*
00004: import ke.pcea.connect.shared.api.BusinessRuleException
00005: import org.springframework.stereotype.Service
00006: import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional
00007: 
00008: @Service
00009: @Transactional(readOnly = true)
00010: class MediaService(
00011:     private val sermonRepo: SermonRepository,
00012:     private val playlistRepo: MediaPlaylistRepository,
00013:     private val itemRepo: MediaPlaylistItemRepository
00014: ) {
00015:     fun getAll() = sermonRepo.findByOrderByPublishedAtDesc()
00016:     fun getByCategory(category: String) = sermonRepo.findByCategoryOrderByPublishedAtDesc(category)
00017:     fun getLive() = sermonRepo.findByIsLiveTrue()
00018:     fun getSermon(id: String) = sermonRepo.findById(id).orElseThrow { BusinessRuleException("Not found") }
00019: 
00020:     @Transactional
00021:     fun createSermon(title: String, description: String, preacher: String, scriptureRef: String,
00022:                      type: MediaType, videoUrl: String, audioUrl: String, thumbnailUrl: String,
00023:                      category: String): Sermon {
00024:         val sermon = Sermon(title = title, description = description, preacher = preacher,
00025:             scriptureRef = scriptureRef, type = type, videoUrl = videoUrl, audioUrl = audioUrl,
00026:             thumbnailUrl = thumbnailUrl, category = category)
00027:         return sermonRepo.save(sermon)
00028:     }
00029: 
00030:     // Playlists
00031:     fun getPlaylists(userId: String) = playlistRepo.findByCreatedBy(userId)
00032:     @Transactional fun createPlaylist(name: String, description: String, userId: String) =
00033:         playlistRepo.save(MediaPlaylist(name = name, description = description, createdBy = userId))
00034: 
00035:     fun getPlaylistItems(playlistId: String) = itemRepo.findByPlaylistIdOrderByPosition(playlistId)
00036:         .mapNotNull { item -> sermonRepo.findById(item.sermonId).orElse(null) }
00037: 
00038:     @Transactional fun addToPlaylist(playlistId: String, sermonId: String) {
00039:         val maxPos = itemRepo.findByPlaylistIdOrderByPosition(playlistId).maxOfOrNull { it.position } ?: 0
00040:         itemRepo.save(MediaPlaylistItem(playlistId = playlistId, sermonId = sermonId, position = maxPos + 1))
00041:     }
00042: }

00001: package ke.pcea.connect.modules.membership.api.controller
00002: import ke.pcea.connect.modules.identity.infrastructure.UserRepository
00003: import ke.pcea.connect.modules.membership.application.MembershipService
00004: import ke.pcea.connect.modules.membership.domain.MemberProfile
00005: import ke.pcea.connect.shared.api.ApiResponse
00006: import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity
00007: import org.springframework.security.core.Authentication
00008: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*
00009: 
00010: @RestController
00011: @RequestMapping("/api/membership-card")
00012: class MembershipCardController(
00013:     private val userRepo: UserRepository,
00014:     private val membershipService: MembershipService
00015: ) {
00016:     @GetMapping
00017:     fun getCard(auth: Authentication): ResponseEntity<ApiResponse<Map<String, Any?>>> {
00018:         val userId = auth.name
00019:         val user = userRepo.findById(userId).orElseThrow()
00020:         var profile: MemberProfile? = null
00021:         try {
00022:             profile = membershipService.getProfile(userId)
00023:         } catch (_: Exception) { }
00024:         val card = mapOf(
00025:             "id" to user.id,
00026:             "fullName" to user.fullName,
00027:             "email" to user.email,
00028:             "phone" to user.phone,
00029:             "congregationName" to (user.congregation?.name ?: ""),
00030:             "memberSince" to (profile?.membershipDate?.toString() ?: ""),
00031:             "gender" to (profile?.gender ?: ""),
00032:             "qrCode" to "https://api.qrserver.com/v1/create-qr-code/?size=150x150&data=MEMBER:${user.id}"
00033:         )
00034:         return ResponseEntity.ok(ApiResponse.success(card))
00035:     }
00036: }

00038:         existing.emergencyPhone = updated.emergencyPhone
00039:         existing.address = updated.address

00041:         existing.postalCode = updated.postalCode
00042:         existing.country = updated.country

00045:         return profileRepo.save(existing)

00001: package ke.pcea.connect.modules.ministries.application
00002: import ke.pcea.connect.modules.ministries.domain.*
00003: import ke.pcea.connect.modules.ministries.infrastructure.*
00004: import org.springframework.stereotype.Service
00005: import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional
00006: import java.time.LocalDateTime
00007: 
00008: data class MinistryFeedItem(
00009:     val id: String,
00010:     val type: String,
00011:     val title: String,
00012:     val description: String,
00013:     val timestamp: LocalDateTime,
00014:     val imageUrl: String? = null
00015: )
00016: 
00017: @Service
00018: @Transactional(readOnly = true)
00019: class MinistryFeedService(
00020:     private val eventRepo: MinistryEventRepository,
00021:     private val projectRepo: MinistryProjectRepository,
00022:     private val galleryRepo: MinistryGalleryRepository
00023: ) {
00024:     fun getFeed(ministryId: String): List<MinistryFeedItem> {
00025:         val items = mutableListOf<MinistryFeedItem>()
00026:         eventRepo.findByMinistryId(ministryId).mapTo(items) { e ->
00027:             MinistryFeedItem(e.id, "event", e.title, e.description ?: "", e.startTime)
00028:         }
00029:         projectRepo.findByMinistryId(ministryId).mapTo(items) { p ->
00030:             MinistryFeedItem(p.id, "project", p.name, p.description ?: "", p.startDate)
00031:         }
00032:         galleryRepo.findByMinistryId(ministryId).mapTo(items) { g ->
00033:             MinistryFeedItem(g.id, "gallery", g.caption, "", g.uploadedAt, g.imageUrl)
00034:         }
00035:         return items.sortedByDescending { it.timestamp }
00036:     }
00037: }

00001: package ke.pcea.connect.modules.ministries.application
00002: import ke.pcea.connect.modules.ministries.domain.*

00007: 
00008: @Service
00009: @Transactional
00010: class MinistryService(
00011:     private val ministryRepo: MinistryRepository,
00012:     private val memberRepo: MinistryMemberRepository,
00013:     private val eventRepo: MinistryEventRepository,
00014:     private val projectRepo: MinistryProjectRepository
00015: ) {
00016:     fun createMinistry(name: String, type: MinistryType, description: String, congregationId: String): Ministry {
00017:         val ministry = Ministry(name = name, type = type, description = description, congregationId = congregationId)
00018:         return ministryRepo.save(ministry)
00019:     }
00020: 
00021:     fun getAllMinistries() = ministryRepo.findAll()
00022:     fun getMinistriesByCongregation(congregationId: String) = ministryRepo.findByCongregationId(congregationId)
00023: 
00024:     fun addMember(ministryId: String, userId: String, role: MinistryRole): MinistryMember {
00025:         val ministry = ministryRepo.findById(ministryId).orElseThrow { BusinessRuleException("Ministry not found") }
00026:         val existing = memberRepo.findByMinistryIdAndUserId(ministryId, userId)
00027:         if (existing != null) throw BusinessRuleException("User already a member")
00028:         val member = MinistryMember(ministry = ministry, userId = userId, role = role)
00029:         return memberRepo.save(member)
00030:     }
00031: 
00032:     fun getMembers(ministryId: String) = memberRepo.findByMinistryId(ministryId)
00033: 
00034:     fun createEvent(ministryId: String, title: String, description: String, startTime: java.time.LocalDateTime,
00035:                     endTime: java.time.LocalDateTime?, location: String): MinistryEvent {
00036:         val ministry = ministryRepo.findById(ministryId).orElseThrow { BusinessRuleException("Ministry not found") }
00037:         val event = MinistryEvent(title = title, description = description, ministry = ministry,
00038:             startTime = startTime, endTime = endTime, location = location)
00039:         return eventRepo.save(event)
00040:     }
00041: 
00042:     fun getEvents(ministryId: String) = eventRepo.findByMinistryId(ministryId)
00043: 
00044:     fun createProject(ministryId: String, name: String, description: String, startDate: java.time.LocalDateTime,
00045:                       endDate: java.time.LocalDateTime?): MinistryProject {
00046:         val ministry = ministryRepo.findById(ministryId).orElseThrow { BusinessRuleException("Ministry not found") }
00047:         val project = MinistryProject(name = name, description = description, ministry = ministry,
00048:             startDate = startDate, endDate = endDate)
00049:         return projectRepo.save(project)
00050:     }
00051: 
00052:     fun getProjects(ministryId: String) = projectRepo.findByMinistryId(ministryId)
00053: }

00017: ) {

00019:     // Replace with your Firebase server key
00020:     private val fcmServerKey = "YOUR_FCM_SERVER_KEY"
00021: 
00022:     fun registerDevice(userId: String, token: String, platform: String) {
00023:         val existing = deviceTokenRepo.findByUserId(userId).find { it.token == token }
00024:         if (existing == null) {
00025:             deviceTokenRepo.save(DeviceToken(userId = userId, token = token, platform = platform))
00026:         }
00027:     }
00028: 
00029:     fun sendPushNotification(recipientId: String, title: String, body: String) {
00030:         val tokens = deviceTokenRepo.findByUserId(recipientId)
00031:         tokens.forEach { dt ->
00032:             val payload = mapOf(
00033:                 "to" to dt.token,
00034:                 "notification" to mapOf("title" to title, "body" to body)
00035:             )
00036:             val headers = HttpHeaders().apply {
00037:                 contentType = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON
00038:                 set("Authorization", "key=$fcmServerKey")
00039:             }
00040:             try {
00041:                 restTemplate.postForEntity(
00042:                     "https://fcm.googleapis.com/fcm/send",
00043:                     HttpEntity(payload, headers),
00044:                     String::class.java
00045:                 )
00046:                 logRepo.save(NotificationLog(title = title, body = body, recipientId = recipientId, channel = "PUSH"))
00047:             } catch (e: Exception) {
00048:                 logRepo.save(NotificationLog(title = title, body = body, recipientId = recipientId, channel = "PUSH", status = "FAILED"))
00049:             }
00050:         }
00051:     }
00052: 
00053:     fun sendEmailNotification(recipientId: String, title: String, body: String) {
00054:         // Mock email sending – replace with real SMTP integration
00055:         logRepo.save(NotificationLog(title = title, body = body, recipientId = recipientId, channel = "EMAIL"))
00056:     }
00057: 
00058:     fun sendSmsNotification(recipientId: String, title: String, body: String) {
00059:         // Mock SMS sending – replace with real gateway integration
00060:         logRepo.save(NotificationLog(title = title, body = body, recipientId = recipientId, channel = "SMS"))
00061:     }
00062: 
00063:     fun sendInAppNotification(recipientId: String, title: String, body: String) {
00064:         logRepo.save(NotificationLog(title = title, body = body, recipientId = recipientId, channel = "IN_APP"))
00065:     }
00066: 
00067:     fun scheduleNotification(title: String, body: String, targetType: String, targetId: String, channel: String, scheduledAt: LocalDateTime): ScheduledNotification {
00068:         val sched = ScheduledNotification(title = title, body = body, targetType = targetType, targetId = targetId, channel = channel, scheduledAt = scheduledAt)
00069:         return scheduledRepo.save(sched)
00070:     }
00071: 
00072:     fun getScheduledNotifications() = scheduledRepo.findAll()
00073: 
00074:     @Scheduled(fixedRate = 60000) // check every minute
00075:     fun processScheduledNotifications() {
00076:         val now = LocalDateTime.now()
00077:         val due = scheduledRepo.findBySentFalseAndScheduledAtBefore(now)
00078:         due.forEach { sched ->
00079:             when (sched.channel) {
00080:                 "PUSH" -> sendPushNotification(sched.targetId, sched.title, sched.body)
00081:                 "EMAIL" -> sendEmailNotification(sched.targetId, sched.title, sched.body)
00082:                 "SMS" -> sendSmsNotification(sched.targetId, sched.title, sched.body)
00083:                 "IN_APP" -> sendInAppNotification(sched.targetId, sched.title, sched.body)
00084:             }
00085:             sched.sent = true
00086:             scheduledRepo.save(sched)
00087:         }
00088:     }
00089: 
00090:     fun getLogs() = logRepo.findAllByOrderBySentAtDesc()
00091:     fun getLogsForUser(userId: String) = logRepo.findByRecipientId(userId)
00092: }

00001: package ke.pcea.connect.modules.pastoralcare.application

00003: import ke.pcea.connect.modules.pastoralcare.infrastructure.*
00004: import ke.pcea.connect.shared.api.BusinessRuleException
00005: import org.springframework.stereotype.Service
00006: import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional
00007: import java.time.LocalDateTime
00008: 
00009: @Service
00010: @Transactional
00011: class PastoralCareService(
00012:     private val prayerRepo: PrayerRequestRepository,
00013:     private val visitRepo: PastoralVisitRepository,
00014:     private val taskRepo: PastoralTaskRepository
00015: ) {
00016:     fun submitPrayerRequest(userId: String, request: String, isAnonymous: Boolean): PrayerRequest {
00017:         val pr = PrayerRequest(userId = userId, request = request, isAnonymous = isAnonymous)
00018:         return prayerRepo.save(pr)
00019:     }
00020: 
00021:     fun getPrayerRequestsForUser(userId: String) = prayerRepo.findByUserId(userId)
00022:     fun getAllPrayerRequests() = prayerRepo.findAll()
00023:     fun updatePrayerStatus(requestId: String, status: PrayerStatus, prayedBy: String): PrayerRequest {
00024:         val pr = prayerRepo.findById(requestId).orElseThrow { BusinessRuleException("Prayer request not found") }
00025:         pr.status = status
00026:         pr.prayedBy = prayedBy
00027:         return prayerRepo.save(pr)
00028:     }
00029: 
00030:     fun scheduleVisit(userId: String, type: VisitType, visitorId: String, scheduledAt: LocalDateTime, notes: String): PastoralVisit {
00031:         val visit = PastoralVisit(userId = userId, type = type, visitorId = visitorId, scheduledAt = scheduledAt, notes = notes)
00032:         return visitRepo.save(visit)
00033:     }
00034: 
00035:     fun completeVisit(visitId: String, notes: String, followUpNeeded: Boolean): PastoralVisit {
00036:         val visit = visitRepo.findById(visitId).orElseThrow { BusinessRuleException("Visit not found") }
00037:         visit.completedAt = LocalDateTime.now()
00038:         visit.notes = notes
00039:         visit.followUpNeeded = followUpNeeded
00040:         return visitRepo.save(visit)
00041:     }
00042: 
00043:     fun getVisitsForUser(userId: String) = visitRepo.findByUserId(userId)
00044: 
00045:     fun createTask(title: String, description: String, assignedTo: String, priority: TaskPriority, dueDate: LocalDateTime?): PastoralTask {
00046:         val task = PastoralTask(title = title, description = description, assignedTo = assignedTo, priority = priority, dueDate = dueDate)
00047:         return taskRepo.save(task)
00048:     }
00049: 
00050:     fun updateTaskStatus(taskId: String, status: TaskStatus): PastoralTask {
00051:         val task = taskRepo.findById(taskId).orElseThrow { BusinessRuleException("Task not found") }
00052:         task.status = status
00053:         if (status == TaskStatus.COMPLETED) task.completedAt = LocalDateTime.now()
00054:         return taskRepo.save(task)
00055:     }
00056: 
00057:     fun getTasksForUser(userId: String) = taskRepo.findByAssignedTo(userId)
00058: }

00001: package ke.pcea.connect.modules.search.api.controller
00002: import ke.pcea.connect.modules.bible.infrastructure.BibleVerseRepository
00003: import ke.pcea.connect.modules.church.infrastructure.CongregationRepository
00004: import ke.pcea.connect.modules.events.infrastructure.EventRepository
00005: import ke.pcea.connect.modules.feed.infrastructure.FeedPostRepository
00006: import ke.pcea.connect.modules.identity.infrastructure.UserRepository
00007: import ke.pcea.connect.modules.media.infrastructure.SermonRepository
00008: import ke.pcea.connect.modules.ministries.infrastructure.MinistryRepository
00009: import ke.pcea.connect.shared.api.ApiResponse
00010: import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity
00011: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*
00012: 
00013: @RestController
00014: @RequestMapping("/api/search")
00015: class SearchController(
00016:     private val userRepo: UserRepository,
00017:     private val congregationRepo: CongregationRepository,
00018:     private val sermonRepo: SermonRepository,
00019:     private val eventRepo: EventRepository,
00020:     private val ministryRepo: MinistryRepository,
00021:     private val postRepo: FeedPostRepository,
00022:     private val bibleVerseRepo: BibleVerseRepository
00023: ) {
00024:     @GetMapping
00025:     fun search(@RequestParam q: String): ResponseEntity<ApiResponse<Map<String, List<Any>>>> {
00026:         val query = q.trim().lowercase()
00027:         val results = mapOf(
00028:             "members" to userRepo.findAll().filter { it.fullName.lowercase().contains(query) || it.email.lowercase().contains(query) }.take(5),
00029:             "congregations" to congregationRepo.findAll().filter { it.name.lowercase().contains(query) || it.address.lowercase().contains(query) }.take(5),
00030:             "sermons" to sermonRepo.findAll().filter { it.title.lowercase().contains(query) || it.preacher.lowercase().contains(query) }.take(5),
00031:             "events" to eventRepo.findAll().filter { it.title.lowercase().contains(query) || it.location.lowercase().contains(query) }.take(5),
00032:             "ministries" to ministryRepo.findAll().filter { it.name.lowercase().contains(query) }.take(5),
00033:             "posts" to postRepo.findAll().filter { it.content.lowercase().contains(query) }.take(5),
00034:             "bible_verses" to bibleVerseRepo.findAll().filter { it.text.lowercase().contains(query) }.take(5)
00035:         )
00036:         return ResponseEntity.ok(ApiResponse.success(results))
00037:     }
00038: }

00017:         teamRepo.save(VolunteerTeam(name = name, description = description, congregationId = congregationId))

00019:

00021:         scheduleRepo.save(VolunteerSchedule(teamId = teamId, eventName = eventName, scheduledAt = scheduledAt, durationMinutes = durationMinutes))

00033:         signup.attended = true
00034:         return signupRepo.save(signup)
00035:     }
00036:     fun recordHours(userId: String, teamId: String, hours: Double): VolunteerServiceHours =
00037:         hoursRepo.save(VolunteerServiceHours(userId = userId, teamId = teamId, hours = hours))

FILE: .\src\main\kotlin\ke\pcea\connect\shared\security\JwtAuthFilter.kt
============================================================
00001: package ke.pcea.connect.shared.security
00002: import jakarta.servlet.FilterChain
00003: import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest
00004: import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse
00005: import org.springframework.security.authentication.UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken
00006: import org.springframework.security.core.authority.SimpleGrantedAuthority
00007: import org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder
00008: import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
00009: import org.springframework.web.filter.OncePerRequestFilter
00010: 
00011: @Component
00012: class JwtAuthFilter(private val jwtService: JwtService) : OncePerRequestFilter() {
00013:     override fun doFilterInternal(request: HttpServletRequest, response: HttpServletResponse, filterChain: FilterChain) {
00014:         val header = request.getHeader("Authorization")
00015:         if (header != null && header.startsWith("Bearer ")) {
00016:             val token = header.substring(7)
00017:             if (jwtService.validateToken(token)) {
00018:                 val userId = jwtService.getUserIdFromToken(token)
00019:                 // Roles were embedded in the token at login but never read back out here,
00020:                 // so every authenticated request previously carried zero authorities and
00021:                 // @PreAuthorize/hasRole checks could never pass for anyone.
00022:                 val authorities = jwtService.getRolesFromToken(token).map { SimpleGrantedAuthority("ROLE_$it") }
00023:                 val auth = UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken(userId, null, authorities)
00024:                 SecurityContextHolder.getContext().authentication = auth
00025:             }
00026:         }
00027:         filterChain.doFilter(request, response)
00028:     }
00029: }

FILE: .\src\main\kotlin\ke\pcea\connect\shared\security\JwtService.kt
============================================================
00001: package ke.pcea.connect.shared.security
00002: import io.jsonwebtoken.Jwts
00003: import io.jsonwebtoken.security.Keys
00004: import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value
00005: import org.springframework.stereotype.Service
00006: import java.util.*
00007: import javax.crypto.SecretKey
00008: @Service
00009: class JwtService(
00010:     @Value("\${jwt.secret}") secret: String,
00011:     @Value("\${jwt.expiration-ms}") private val expirationMs: Long,
00012:     @Value("\${jwt.refresh-expiration-ms}") private val refreshExpirationMs: Long
00013: ) {
00014:     private val signingKey: SecretKey = Keys.hmacShaKeyFor(secret.toByteArray())
00015:     fun generateToken(userId: String, roles: List<String> = emptyList()): String {
00016:         val now = Date()
00017:         return Jwts.builder().subject(userId).claim("roles", roles)
00018:             .issuedAt(now).expiration(Date(now.time + expirationMs))
00019:             .signWith(signingKey).compact()
00020:     }
00021:     fun generateRefreshToken(userId: String): String {
00022:         val now = Date()
00023:         return Jwts.builder().subject(userId).issuedAt(now)
00024:             .expiration(Date(now.time + refreshExpirationMs)).signWith(signingKey).compact()
00025:     }
00026:     fun validateToken(token: String): Boolean {
00027:         return try { Jwts.parser().verifyWith(signingKey).build().parseSignedClaims(token); true } catch (e: Exception) { false }
00028:     }
00029:     fun getUserIdFromToken(token: String): String {
00030:         return Jwts.parser().verifyWith(signingKey).build().parseSignedClaims(token).payload.subject
00031:     }
00032: 
00033:     @Suppress("UNCHECKED_CAST")
00034:     fun getRolesFromToken(token: String): List<String> {
00035:         val claims = Jwts.parser().verifyWith(signingKey).build().parseSignedClaims(token).payload
00036:         return (claims["roles"] as? List<*>)?.mapNotNull { it as? String } ?: emptyList()
00037:     }
00038: }

FILE: .\src\main\kotlin\ke\pcea\connect\shared\security\RateLimitingFilter.kt
============================================================
00001: package ke.pcea.connect.shared.security
00002: import jakarta.servlet.*
00003: import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest
00004: import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse
00005: import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
00006: import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap
00007: import java.time.Instant
00008: 
00009: @Component
00010: class RateLimitingFilter : Filter {
00011:     private val requestCounts = ConcurrentHashMap<String, MutableList<Instant>>()
00012: 
00013:     override fun doFilter(request: ServletRequest, response: ServletResponse, chain: FilterChain) {
00014:         val httpRequest = request as HttpServletRequest
00015:         val httpResponse = response as HttpServletResponse
00016:         val path = httpRequest.requestURI
00017: 
00018:         if (path.startsWith("/api/auth/login") || path.startsWith("/api/auth/register")) {
00019:             val clientIp = httpRequest.remoteAddr
00020:             val now = Instant.now()
00021:             val window = now.minusSeconds(60)
00022:             val timestamps = requestCounts.getOrPut(clientIp) { mutableListOf() }
00023:             timestamps.removeIf { it.isBefore(window) }
00024:             if (timestamps.size >= 10) {
00025:                 httpResponse.status = 429
00026:                 httpResponse.writer.write("Too many requests. Please try again later.")
00027:                 return
00028:             }
00029:             timestamps.add(now)
00030:         }
00031:         chain.doFilter(request, response)
00032:     }
00033: }
